name: Kepler Robotics
summary: Kepler Robotics (Shanghai Kepler Exploration Robot Co.) is a Shanghai humanoid maker led by CEO Debo Hu, focused on industrial humanoids such as the K2 Bumblebee. In May 2026 Hangzhou Kelin acquired a 51% controlling stake.
funding: Hangzhou Kelin bought 51% for about 722 million yuan in May 2026, valuing Kepler below an earlier 1.06 billion yuan valuation (BigGo Finance).

sources.title: Kepler Robotics showcases K2 Bumblebee humanoid at ICRA 2025
